BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fish protection costs; and adding a new sectionto chapter 19.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each electric utility that has more than ten thousand retailelectric customers must provide its retail electric customers with anannual notice, in easily understandable language, concerning thepercentage of the customer's bill that is directly attributable to thecosts for fish protection. The utility may estimate the costsattributable to fish protection. Each electric utility that has ten thousand retail electriccustomers or fewer is encouraged to provide its retail electriccustomers with an annual notice, in easily understandable language,concerning the percentage of the customer's bill that is directlyattributable to the costs for fish protection. The utility mayestimate the costs attributable to fish protection. Notice under this section may be provided in customers' billing p. 1 SSB 5268statements or through the utility's annual report required under thischapter.
